chunks: "Indeed, the pilgrim, from the time he leaves his home until he returns, is in the rank of one circumambulating the Kaaba."

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Kaaba, the Sacred House in Mecca
key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: in the rank or status of
key_terms.مَنْزِلِهِ: his home or dwelling from which he departs

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of a pilgrim from the time of leaving home until returning from hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the elevated spiritual status of the pilgrim throughout the entire journey of hajj, not only during the rites themselves. It emphasizes the continuous merit and sanctity of the pilgrim's travel from departure until return.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The pilgrim, from the moment they leave their home until they return, is in the status of one performing Tawaf around the Kaaba."
